scope: Public identity-disjoint query calibration/holdout experiment, not campus or training-independent acceptance

sampling.gallery: One fixed 24-identity gallery with four references each, shared by calibration and holdout; query identities are disjoint
sampling.exclude: All identities/images downloaded, inspected or used in prior pilot, calibration, retired selection attempts and reference ablation; all prior dog source paths
sampling.capture_sessions: Unavailable in source; identity partitioning does not establish reference/query capture-session independence

candidate_policies.margin_definition: Top identity score minus second distinct identity score; a positive margin requires a second identity
candidate_policies.selection_order: Among policies meeting all calibration targets: maximize known correct confirmations, minimize unknown/no-cat false accepts, minimize known wrong confirmations, prefer zero margin, then higher confirmed threshold, then higher margin
candidate_policies.no_feasible_policy: Report calibration targets unmet; do not open holdout or change defaults

holdout_rules: Freeze manifests and this protocol in Git before running calibration inference
Select the policy using only calibration predictions; freeze selected policy and its calibration/protocol hashes in Git before holdout inference
Open the holdout once with the frozen policy; report failures without retuning on holdout
Compare legacy 0.57/0.49/zero-margin policy using the same raw holdout ranks; rankings are independent of confirmation thresholds
Targets are empirical sample rates, not statistical guarantees; report counts and identity-level error concentration
If holdout targets fail, retain the candidate as experimental and leave release-quality verification open
This is one new study following a diagnosed preprocessing/coverage change, not repeated reseeding until targets pass. A failed new calibration stops before opening holdout.
limitations: Model training overlap unknown; provider did not publish its 131-cat training manifest
Cat identities are source labels, not owner-verified identities
AFHQ dog photos lack individual identity/session metadata; image-disjoint partitions may still contain correlated subjects
Dog negatives do not cover toys, screens, multiple cats or production upload distributions
Changing gallery size, model or image domain requires fresh calibration and validation

development_selection.fresh_policy_selection: Use only the new calibration partition and the unchanged 32-policy grid; old calibration policy is not promoted directly
